newsitem.title: UK: BFI down two as holiday approach quietens market.
newsitem.headline: BFI down two as holiday approach quietens market.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down two on Tuesday to 1,524 points, the first fall in the index since March 5 as panellists marked down most BFI routes marginally.
Forthcoming holiday influences and continuing problems in the Mississippi have lead to a general decline in chartering activity, brokers said.
The Baltic Handy Index also moved very little but in the opposite direction, up three to 1,107.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was down five points to unchanged and turnover totalled 94 lots.
